programme.title: iCarly: iGoodbye - Parte 1
programme.desc: Carly vorrebbe andare alla tradizionale festa "padri-figlie" che si tiene in una base militare di Seattle, dove suo padre la portava sempre quand'era una bambina...

programme.title: iCarly: iGoodbye - Parte 2
programme.desc: Carly è terribilmente delusa dalla piega che hanno preso gli eventi. Freddie e Gibby si offrono di accompagnarla alla festa ma lei rifiuta, inconsolabile. Proprio in quel momento però...

programme.title: iCarly: iPilot
programme.desc: Carly si occupa dello show della scuola. Subito si diffonde una grande clamore. Così Carly e i suoi amici decidono di creare uno show di intrattenimento settimanale.

programme.title: iCarly: Io amo Jake
programme.desc: Carly è eccitata per il fatto che Jake, il ragazzo di cui è innamorata, abbia acconsentito a cantare all'interno del loro webcast.

programme.title: iCarly: Io voglio più visitatori
programme.desc: Carly e Sam sfidano Freddie e Spencer in una gara su chi riesce ad attrarre il maggior numero di spettatori nello show. Tutti impazziscono quando i ragazzi mettono in atto i loro piani.

programme.title: iCarly: Io e Nevel
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie vorrebbero che il loro show fosse recensito. Carly rischia di ricevere una cattiva pubblicità quando insulta il supponente ragazzino undicenne che gestisce un popolare sito che dà i voti ai siti web.

programme.title: iCarly: Voglio stare con Spencer
programme.desc: Il nonno di Carly arriva per una visita ma è colpito dall'insolito comportamento di Spencer, cosicchè contesta la capacità di Spencer di sentirsi responsabile. Carly deve convincerlo che Spencer è in grado di fare il custode.

programme.title: iCarly: Intrappolati in casa Briggs
programme.desc: Il tema per il prossimo webcast di iCarly è capire che cosa significa fare gli insegnanti al di fuori della scuola. Quando Carly e Freddie seguono la signora Briggs, essi rimangono bloccati dentro la sua casa.

programme.title: iCarly: Un record da battere
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie vogliono battere il precedente record del mondo della più lunga trasmissione web in diretta, che è di poco più di 24 ore. L'impresa si rivela tutt'altro che facile.

programme.title: iCarly: Un appuntamento per Freddy
programme.desc: Valerie, una ragazza dalla scuola, mostra interesse per Freddie, così i due si fidanzano. La ragazza cerca di strappare via Freddie da iCarly per realizzare un suo webcast e cosìCerca anche di reclutare Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: L'arte nel cuore
programme.desc: Spencer si deprime e smette di interessarsi di arte dopo che il suo idolo critica il suo lavoro. Carly cerca di alleviare la sua delusione mostrando alcune delle sculture di Spencer nello show.

programme.title: iCarly: Io sono la vostra più grande fan
programme.sub-title: Io sono la vostra più grande fan
programme.desc: Carly invita il suo più grande fan ad assistere a una registrazione live di iCarly, ma la ragazza è così ossessionata che non riescono a sbarazzarsi di lei.

programme.title: iCarly: Pulcini da salvare
programme.desc: Carly e Sam devono fare una ricerca scolastica e scelgono di far schiudere in casa delle uova. L'argomento sembra interessante e le ragazze decidono anche di mostrare su iCarly l'intero processo che porterà alla nascita dei pulcini.

programme.title: iCarly: Il litigio
programme.desc: Carly regala a Sam una maglietta che ha creato apposta per lei, con il logo di iCarly e le loro facce sopra. Sam, per ricambiare, vorrebbe regalarle i biglietti per il concerto di un gruppo.

programme.title: iCarly: Il sogno di ballare
programme.desc: Per i loro balletti, Carly e Sam prendono ispirazione dai video inviati dai fans del loro web show. Carly si divincola in modo maldestro in sogno con il suo affascinante partner.

programme.title: iCarly: La notte di Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie trasmettono il loro webcast di Halloween da un appartamento che si dice essere abitato dai fantasmi.

programme.title: iCarly: Il sabotaggio
programme.desc: I Plain White T's devono suonare ad iCarly, ma Nevel progetta di sabotare l'evento facendo hackeraggio sul sito.

programme.title: iCarly: La punizione
programme.desc: Sam viene punita dal professor Horward, il più tremendo di tutto l'istituto, ed è costretta a tornare la sera a scuola, proprio il giorno in cui deve andare in onda la 50esima puntata di ICarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Uno sponsor per iCarly
programme.desc: Un'azienda produttrice di scarpe chiede a Carly, Sam e Freddie di lanciare nella loro trasmissione web un nuovo modello di scarpe da tennis, molto trendy e tecnologiche.

programme.title: iCarly: La promessa
programme.desc: Carly ottiene una B nel compito di storia e si intristisce perchè pensa di meritare di più. Sam penetra nel computer della scuola per modificare il voto e così va tutto a posto, finchè Carly si trova a dover fare i conti con la propria coscienza.

programme.title: iCarly: Va in TV
programme.desc: Visto il successo che iCarly riscuote sul web, il funzionario di un'emittente televisiva contatta i ragazzi e propone loro di trasferire gli episodi in televisione.

programme.title: iCarly: L'odioso ragazzo di Sam
programme.desc: Quando la nuova relazione di Sam inizia a influire negativamente sullo show, Carly e Freddie fanno di tutto per far sì che Sam e il suo nuovo fidanzato si lascino.

programme.title: iCarly: L'appostamento
programme.desc: La polizia di Seattle è sulle tracce di un venditore di DVD pirata che compare per caso in una delle trasmissioni di iCarly. Due poliziotti organizzano un appostamento nell'appartamento di Carly.

programme.title: iCarly: Scuola nuova, amici nuovi
programme.desc: Carly riceve un invito per un colloquio con la preside della Briarwood, una scuola costosa e rinomata.

programme.title: iCarly: Scherma e schermaglie
programme.desc: Nonostante Freddie si diverta a passare il tempo libero con Carly e Sam a realizzare il web-show, sente l'esigenza di stare anche con dei ragazzi e fare cose da "maschi".

programme.title: iCarly: Vinci un incontro galante
programme.desc: Gibby è segretamente innamorato di Shannon, ma sa che non riuscirà mai a conquistarla, perché a lei piace Freddie.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly va in Giappone - parte 1
programme.desc: Il web show iCarly è stato nominato agli International iWeb Awards. Carly, Sam e Freddie partono alla volta del Giappone accompagnati da Spencer e dalla madre di Freddie.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly va in Giappone - parte 2
programme.desc: Salvati da un poliziotto, Carly e i suoi amici arrivano in albergo. Qui incontrano Kyoko e Yuki, due ragazzi il cui web show è in lizza per lo stesso premio per cui è stato candidato iCarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly va in Giappone - parte 3
programme.desc: Spencer e la Sig.ra Benson trovano i ragazzi e li riportano a Tokyo, dove lo spettacolo degli iWeb Awards è già cominciato. Le guardie di sicurezza però non vogliono farli entrare.

programme.title: iCarly: L'ho visto prima io!
programme.desc: Freddie ha invitato un amico all'iCarly show e sia Carly che Sam si prendono una cotta per lui appena il nuovo ragazzo entra nello studio.

programme.title: iCarly: La partita infinita
programme.desc: Spencer trova in una discarica un vecchio videogioco e da quando comincia a giocarci, non riesce più a staccarsi.

programme.title: iCarly: Il debito di Sam
programme.desc: Sam ha collezionato un debito molto consistente con Carly e Freddie, che le chiedono di restituire i soldi.

programme.title: iCarly: Scherzo col botto
programme.desc: In una puntata del loro web show, Carly, Sam e Freddie fanno uno scherzo "in diretta" a Lewbert, il portiere del palazzo in cui vive Carly.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La griglia di Gary
programme.desc: Drake e Josh vengono ingaggiati da due individui per vendere griglie dotate di lettore mp3 incorporato. I due ragazzi si rivelano abili venditori ma vengono interrotti dalla polizia che li arresta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Drew & Jerry
programme.desc: Drake dice al fratello che vorrebbe avere più tempo da trascorre da solo e Josh lo accontenta trovandosi un nuovo amico: Drew. Che, guarda a caso, è praticamente una copia di Drake.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Presunto colpevole
programme.desc: All'insegnante di inglese, la signora Hayfer, fanno ritrovare l’auto parcheggiata in mezzo all'aula. La colpa ricade subito sul povero Drake anche perché nel bagagliaio viene trovata la sua giacca.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La locanda di Drake & Josh
programme.desc: Drake vorrebbe lasciare Kelly, la ragazza con cui sta uscendo, ma scopre che è la figlia della sua professoressa d’inglese che è pronta a vendicarsi con il ragazzo se lui farà soffrire la sua bambina.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il peperone peruviano
programme.desc: Josh e Drake partecipano al concorso per la salsa più buona. Megan però viene esclusa dalla squadra e decide di vendicarsi partecipando alla gara e sabotando la loro ricetta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Marito e moglie
programme.desc: L’amica di penna di Josh, Yooka, arriva in america per conoscerlo. E’ una bella ragazza e Drake cerca subito di attirare la sua attenzione e addirittura si ritrova sposato con lei.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Mindy è tornata
programme.desc: Josh si prepara per l’esposizione di scienze. questa volta Mindy non partecipa alla gara, quindi il ragazzo è sicuro di vincere. Sul più bello però Mindy decide di presentarsi.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Relazione Clandestina
programme.desc: Drake sente il padre che parla sottovoce al telefono con una donna e si convince che sia la sua amante. Josh all’inizio non gli crede ma poi insieme al fratello decide di ostacolare questa relazione.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Tastare il terreno
programme.desc: Drake esce con Tori ma decide di lasciarla proprio quando sente la ragazza che lo definisce il suo fidanzato. Josh invece si fa crescere i baffi pensando che così gli altri lo rispettino di più.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: L'intervento di Helen
programme.desc: Josh viene promosso assistente manager del cinema. Il ragazzo cerca di fare il possibile per dimostrare di essere all’altezza dell’incarico ma naturalmente Drake gli mette i bastoni tra le ruote.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il dottor Drake
programme.desc: Josh viene colpito da una patata sparata da Drake. Cerca di nascondere il suo infortunio ma alla fine deve essere ricoverato. Drake invece, si finge medico e si caccia nei guai.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La mano di gomma
programme.desc: Josh racconta di quando a otto anni, allo stadio un bambino l’ha picchiato e gli ha rubato la sua mano in gommapiuma. Quel bambino era Drake e i due cominciano a litigare sulla versione della storia.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Girl power
programme.desc: Mindy invita Josh a cena per fargli conoscere i suoi genitori, ma le cose non vanno bene. Josh organizza un’altra cena a casa sua per cercare di impressionare i genitori di Mindy e rimediare.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il mistero della pecora
programme.desc: Josh e Drake sentono dei rumori che provengono dal garage. Vanno a controllare e trovano una pecora. Arriva Megan che racconta di averla comprata in rete e chiede ai ragazzi di tenerla nascosta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il nuovo insegnante di Megan
programme.desc: Josh viene ammesso in un’associazione che permette agli studenti delle superiori di insegnare ai bambini più piccoli. Il ragazzo capita nella classe di Megan e viene subito preso in antipatia...

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Un Fratellino
programme.desc: Drake si presenta come sempre in ritardo alla lezione della signora Hayfer che già lo detesta. La professoressa decide di punirlo.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il rapinatore di Cinema
programme.desc: Un regista decide di girare la ricostruzione della vita di un pericoloso criminale che rapina cinema al Première e offre a Josh il ruolo da protagonista.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il "demonator"
programme.desc: Vengono inaugurate le più grandi montagne russe al mondo, il 'Demonator' e Drake e Josh vogliono provarle la prima sera dell’apertura.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Invasione Aliena
programme.desc: Drake e Josh decidono di ripagare Megan con la stessa moneta e di vendicarsi per i tanti scherzi subiti. La inducono così a pensare che gli alieni esistono davvero...

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Lo show della dottoressa Phyllis
programme.desc: Drake e Josh ultimamente non fanno altro che litigare e Megan non riesce più a dormire di notte per il chiasso che fanno...

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Hollywood parte 1
programme.desc: Walter e Audrey partono per una crociera di dieci giorni. Drake e Josh non vedono l’ora di avere la casa a loro disposizione dal momento che anche Megan andrà a Denver a trovare un’amichetta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Hollywood parte 2
programme.desc: Arrivati a Los Angeles i fratelli cercano immediatamente la sorella e mentre Drake va in albergo, Josh si reca alla toilette dove conosce Mitch che sta cercando disperatamente un artista musicale...

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Hollywood parte 3
programme.desc: Drake e Josh sono prigionieri della banda di Milo, Deegan e Brice. Dopo qualche tentativo di fuga fallito sembra che per i due ragazzi le cose si mettano davvero male.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Sorprese di compleanno
programme.desc: È il compleanno di Josh e Drake lo dimentica. Il ragazzo resta deluso dal comportamento del fratello ma quando Drake si rende conto della sua dimenticanza, decide di fargli una sopresa.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il feroce Tiberius
programme.desc: Josh si offre volontario per dar da mangiare al cane e innaffiare le piante della signora Hayfer mentre è fuori città. Drake, che è il peggior alunno della signora Hayfer, vuole unirsi al fratello.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La gara di scienze
programme.desc: Mindy confessa a Josh di amarlo e, vista la reazione poco convinta mostrata dal fidanzatino, gli consiglia di riflettere durante il fine settimana prima di comunicarle i suoi sentimenti.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La prozia si sposa
programme.desc: La famiglia di Drake e Josh è invitata al matrimonio della prozia Catherine, un'antipatica e ricchissima novantenne. La famiglia la sopporta perchè spera nell'eredità.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La scommessa
programme.desc: Drake e Josh fanno una scommessa a chi riuscirà a ottenere più appuntamenti con le ragazze in una settimana. Audrey decide di aiutare Josh e il trucco sembra funzionare a meraviglia.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il grande Doheny
programme.desc: Josh incontra al Premiere il famoso mago Henry Doheny, di cui è un grande ammiratore. L’uomo è in città per qualche giorno e il ragazzo si offre di aiutarlo qualora avesse bisogno.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Regalo di anniversario

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il temporale

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La macchina nuova

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La casa sull'albero

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Con te ho chiuso

programme.desc: Isaac's budding relationship with a new crew member becomes complicated when Gopher tells him to fire her. Meanwhile, a congressman and his wife bring their daughter aboard the Pacific Princess after receiving letters threatening her young life.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: The Buck Stops Here/For Better or Worse/Bet on It

programme.title: The Love Boat

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: A Rose Is Not A Rose / Novelties / Too Rich And Too Thin
programme.desc: An inventor's zealousness jeopardizes his chance for romance and a man's double identity upsets Julie and a passenger.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart arrives in North Fork in search of renegade Indians suspected of the brutal killing of a Texas Ranger and his family.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Sid Fallon tries to blackmail former gambler Julia Andueza into allowing him to use her boarding house as a gambling hall and saloon.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas puts his life in jeopardy when he agrees to testify in a murder case where the first witness was killed before he could testify, and the killer is still at large.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Outlaw Sam Morley falls in love with a young woman who has a serious illness and asks Lucas to turn him in for the reward and use the money to pay for her medical care.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas welcomes his old friend Tom Birch, who once saved his life, unaware that the man is now a bank robber on the run with his gang.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Dan Maury, released from Yuma prison, arrives in North Fork intent on getting even with Marshal Torrance, who helped send him to jail.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Young Mark McCain is eager to help lawman Jay Jefferson, who has arrived in North Fork intent on killing an outlaw for the reward, whether he is the right man or not.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas comes to the rescue when escaped convicts hold up the general store in North Fork and take Marshall Torrance hostage.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Young Mark manages to capture a hawk but falls into danger with a rattlesnake. A stranger comes to his rescue and Mark invites the man home, unaware that he is on the run from the law.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas takes in an orphaned teen being raised by his abusive uncle after there is trouble at the school.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The McCains try to be tolerant of their embittered neighbor Abel MacDonald, but they decide he's gone too far when he won't allow his injured boy to get medical treatment.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An unfounded rumor causes North Fork's outspoken feminist schoolteacher to be attacked by a mob of angry townspeople.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When his employer begins to suspect him of embezzlement, bookkeeper Asa Manning decides to hire a professional gunman to take care of the problem.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A drought has forced local cowhands to seek work on a railroad construction project, but executives are afraid workers will desert them if they believe an old man's claim of making rain.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas McCain gives blood to save a dying man and is surprised by Marshall Torrance's odd behavior towards him. Soon, men arrive from a nearby town and demand custody of the man.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Mark finds of the body of a murder victim, Lucas, his friend Artemus and Marshall Torrance begin a search for the killer.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When renegade Apaches wound Lucas and kidnap Mark, Marshall Torrance joins with U.S. Marshall Sam Buckhart to form a rescue posse.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas is the town's representative to the railroad commission until an infamous train robber dies and leaves his ill-gotten wealth to Lucas. Lucas must clear his name.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When a rancher dies after the bank forecloses the mortgage on his property, his son blames the banker for his father's death.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When a wealthy rancher is killed, Mark suggests that they seek the aid of a mind reader to identify the murderer.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A group of outlaws devise a plan to get rid of Lucas so that they can take over the town of North Fork.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: After Lucas kills a mountain man in a brawl, his father arrives in North Fork to break his other boys out of jail and take revenge on Lucas and Marshall Torrance.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Newly arrived gunslinger Al Walker throws a mammoth party at the saloon, keeping acting Marshall Ben Waller busy until Lucas is forced to intervene.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: After Lucas accuses a newspaper writer's misleading articles of causing an innocent man's death, the writer begins writing articles about Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Gavin and Ezra Martin think that Lucas killed their son Clemmie while taking part in a train robbery and Lucas refuses to tell them what really happened.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Eddie's daughter causes trouble for Lucas when two strangers threaten her life after she arrives with criminal information and stolen money.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Town character Brett Conway blackmails Lucas with the knowledge that a young couple Lucas rescued is suffering from yellow fever.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark are stranded in the middle of a desert with very little food or water, and after Lucas is injured, Mark becomes the only hope for their survival.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: While trying to protect Banker Hamilton's gold, Mark is kidnapped and held hostage at the McCain ranch and will be killed within the hour unless Lucas cooperates.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas makes a life-or-death decision when Micah is held hostage and the kidnappers demand the release of a notorious outlaw.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas tries to do a good deed for the old town drunk but it backfires when the drunk's son believes he inherited Lucas' ranch.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Con Rick contra las cuerdas, la guerra contra los Saviors se recrudece e Hilltop, el Reino y Alejandría conocen el verdadero potencial del ejército de Negan.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los Saviors poseen un arma de gran potencia que pretenden transportar para ayudar a Negan. Ezekiel, que ha sobrevivido a la matanza de sus hombres, y Carol, aislada en territorio enemigo, son los únicos que pueden impedir la entrega del arma.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Gabriel y Negan tienen que cooperar para salir con vida de la casa en la que están encerrados, con decenas de muertos vivientes tratando de comérselos. Mientras, los lugartenientes de Negan se dan cuenta de que uno de ellos es un traidor, ¿quién?

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: El rey, la viuda y Rick
programme.desc: Rick visita a Jadis para convencerla de que se una a ellos en la lucha contra Negan. En Hilltop, Gregory sugiere a Maggie, que está enojada con Jesús porque está alimentando a los prisioneros, que los ahorque. Carl se encuentra con Siddiq.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Tara rompen el muro del Santuario y los zombis entran al recinto. Negan exige a Eugene que idee una manera de sacarlos con vida de allí. Jadis prepara a Rick una muerte horrenda.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan y sus hombres atacan a las tres comunidades rebeldes al mismo tiempo. Sin Rick, Carl asume la defensa de Alexandria, cercada por el propio Negan. Mientras, Simon detiene al ejército de Hilltop en la carretera y Gavin quiere capturar a Ezekiel.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carl hace una última petición a Rick y Michonne antes de morir. Mientras tanto, Morgan y Carol intentan rescatar a Ezekiel antes de que Gavin se lo entregue vivo a Negan para que este lo torture y asesine delante de sus seguidores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan ordena a Simon que mate solo a uno de los hombres de Jadis como escarmiento, pero Simon tiene sed de venganza. Mientras, Rick se dirige al basurero del grupo de Jadis para renovar su alianza, y Aaron sigue intentando obtener un acuerdo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: A Maggie se le acaban las reservas de alimentos y debe decidir si deja que los presos pasen hambre. Mientras, Daryl guía a los supervivientes de Alejandría a través de un pantano repleto de zombis, y la adversidad pone a prueba la fe de Gabriel.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick ataca a Negan cuando este se dirigía a Hilltop y terminan enfrentándose en un edificio abandonado, pero Simon y Dwight siguen el rastro de Negan. Mientras tanto, Maggie, Enid, Michonne y Rosita discuten sobre la propuesta de una desconocida.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: No nos lleven por el mal camino
programme.desc: Los Saviors, ahora dirigidos por Simon, atacan Hilltop pese a que algunos de sus combatientes están dentro, presos. Maggie organiza la defensa del poblado, pero ¿podrán evitar una masacre como la que Simon perpetró contra el grupo de Jadis?

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Jadis planea una muerte horrenda para Negan. Mientras, Morgan va en busca de Henry y Rick sale de Hilltop para cazar a los que huyeron durante el asalto comandado por Simon. Finalmente, los dos se encuentran en territorio enemigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras los hombres de Negan continúan con su ofensiva, Aaron sigue buscando aliados nuevos, pese a que pueda costarle la vida. Daryl y Rosita se enfrentan a un viejo amigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las comunidades unen sus fuerzas en la última batalla contra los Salvadores. Negan ha conseguido entregar a Rick un mapa con instrucciones, para así tenderle una emboscada.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large box full of building blocks. He starts building towers, but they keep collapsing whenever he looks away. He discovers a hole in the ground with nothing inside, but curious as ever, he presses a button to inflate himself and blows into one of the holes, causing the troublemaker, a friendly mole, to pop out. Rookie catches his new friend , and together they set up an amazing building.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: In the final episode of the second season, Rookie hears suspicious noises and begins to investigate. But he can‘t find the source! When he finally opens a door, he is greeted by a confetti cannon - a surprise birthday party! All his friends are gathered around a cake with two candles, and at the little turtle’s count, they all join in singing ‘Happy Birthday’ together!

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: En su camino, Chip y sus amigos encuentran una isla rodeada por un gran lago de ácido, bajo la constante amenaza de erupción de un volcán. En la isla viven átomos de lantánidos que, según la leyenda, esperan la llegada de un «elegido» que les proporcione el ácido que les impide abandonar la isla. Chip, gracias a su libro, descubre que el volcán emitió una base que, al mezclarse con el ácido, puede neutralizar el peligroso lago y convertirlo en una agradable extensión de agua salada.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: En medio de un desierto abrasador, Chip y los átomos se encontraron con un átomo de tungsteno que les brindó refugio bajo un edificio piramidal que, hasta hacía poco, contaba con un ingenioso sistema de refrigeración por el que circulaba una corriente de amoníaco en su sótano. Pero ahora, el Dr. No ha desviado el flujo de amoníaco para su propio beneficio. Chip descubre el punto donde se desvía el amoníaco y construye una presa que lo devuelve a su curso normal.

programme.title: RoboFuse

programme.title: RoboFuse

programme.title: RoboFuse

programme.title: Tom's Car Wash

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons

Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Cyboars

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1
programme.desc: Les tortues n'ont toujours pas retrouvé Karaï. L'inquiétude atteint son paroxysme lorsque Splinter leur annonce que l'invasion des Krangs est imminente. Dans la ville, April et Irma sont poursuivies par des Footbots.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2
programme.desc: Suite du premier épisode. Léo se bat contre les acolytes de Shredder et affronte successivement les Footbots, Tiger Claw et Fishface. Puis Shredder porte le dernier coup et fendille sa carapace. Le père d'April est « krang-formé ».

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au fond des bois
programme.desc: Après l'invasion de New York, April, Casey et les tortues trouvent refuge dans la maison de campagne de la famille O'Neil. Trois mois ont passé et Leonardo est toujours inconscient.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La chasse au Big Foot
programme.desc: Raphael organise une partie de cache-cache dans la forêt pour que Mikey et Donnie apprivoisent leur nouvel environnement. Mais ils tombent nez-à-nez avec une créature légendaire, le Big Foot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Secrets enfouis
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'attaque des Grenouilles-Mutantes
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mauvais rêves
programme.desc: En revenant de l'épicerie locale, Casey et April trouvent les tortues faisant la sieste. Casey s'indigne tandis qu'April s'inquiète car elle n'arrive pas à les réveiller.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fou du volant
programme.desc: Casey et Donnie croisent un dangereux chauffard sur la route. Ils apprennent aux informations qu'il est activement recherché et décident de le prendre en chasse.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les yeux de la Chimère
programme.desc: Donatello teste un nouvel appareil sur April, censé mesurer ses pouvoirs psychiques. Mais par un phénomène étrange, elle se met à voir à travers les yeux d'un volatile mutant géant, mélange de lombric, d'oiseau, et de poisson.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Quête spirituelle
programme.desc: Leonardo se fait attaquer par un daim dans la forêt, suite à quoi, il décide d'organiser une retraite pour lui et ses frères afin de se reconnecter avec Mère Nature.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Retour à New York
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent par un flash info que tout va bien à New York, mais que la ville a été mise en quarantaine. Ce message est tout sauf rassurant, et elles décident de retourner dans la grosse pomme.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Chasse au serpent
programme.desc: Les tortues retournent dans leur ancien repaire. Elles en ramènent des souvenirs et autres objets précieux. Leonardo a récupéré le vieux portrait de famille de Maître Splinter. Quand celui-ci revoit Karaï bébé, son émotion est vive et perceptible.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Rhinocéros et le Cochon
programme.desc: Les tortues poursuivent leur mission qui est de retrouver Karaï. Elles ne disposent que d'un seul indice et se séparent pour chercher dans plusieurs lieux sélectionnés par Donnie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La Bataille de New York, première partie
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, première partie
programme.desc: Mikey joue dans le laboratoire de Donnie et fabrique accidentellement du rétro-mutagène. Splinter ordonne aux quatre frères de rendre leur apparence humaine aux New-Yorkais krang-formés par les Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La Bataille de New York, deuxième partie
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, deuxième partie
programme.desc: Les tortues embarquent dans leur ballon dirigeable et partent à l'assaut de la Dimension X.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Casey Jones combat le crime
programme.desc: Casey Jones garde une dent contre les tortues, pour ne pas avoir été du voyage dans la Dimension X. Il aura à cœur de démontrer que la ville de New York peut compter sur lui comme justicier.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Vengeur toxique
programme.desc: Shredder envoie Rocksteady et Bebop récupérer des produits chimiques pour mettre au point un sérum de manipulation mentale pour Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le choc des Mutanimaux
programme.desc: Shredder et Stockman la mouche tiennent enfin la substance indispensable pour mettre au point leur formule de contrôle de la pensée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mon nom est Mondo Gecko
programme.desc: Casey et Mikey font du skate et rencontrent un nouveau mutant, Jason, qui est devenu un gecko.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le venin mortel
programme.desc: Stockman mouche a rendu sa forme humaine à Karaï. Il lui enfonce un parasite dans l'oreille, qui conditionne son cerveau à obéir aux ordres de Shredder sans discuter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Perdus dans le temps
programme.desc: Leo et ses frères font une étrange rencontre, venue du futur. La jeune et belle Reinette est poursuivie par un horrible démon mutant du nom de Savanti Romero. Celui-ci veut lui subtiliser le Sceptre du Temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende des Yokaï
programme.desc: Les quatre frères poursuivent leur voyage dans le temps et se retrouvent au Japon, dans un passé pas si lointain. Aucune trace de Reinette. Par contre, ils sont cernés par des ninjas du clan Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'attaque du Méga Shredder
programme.desc: Après plusieurs tentatives ratées et une entorse au pied, les tortues réussissent à s'introduire dans le labo de Stockman la mouche et dérober un parasite du cerveau. Le but : permettre à Donnie d'inverser le processus et de sauver Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'herbe-barjot
programme.desc: Mikey fait l'idiot dans le labo de Donnie, qui travaille sur un nouveau sérum anti-parasite destiné à Karaï. À force de jouer, il fait tomber des flacons d'une étagère au contenu dangereux et renverse le sérum sur Donnie, mais pas seulement.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Piège puissance quatre
programme.desc: À l'aide des Mascottes de Baxter Stockman, Karaï parvient à attirer les tortues une à une. Elle veut ainsi pousser Splinter à l'affronter en duel. Mais son plan machiavélique ne s'arrête pas là...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Un dinosaure dans les égouts !
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (1/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Die Invasion Teil 2

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Dans la ligne de mire
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers doivent récupérer un nouveau laser sonique sophistiqué et mortel tombé entre de mauvaises mains.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Le Grand Nettoyage

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La Marque du dragon noir

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La Couleur de l'intolérance

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Le Retour du général

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Casa Diablo (Partie 1)

programme.desc: Le week-end de camping de Walker, pour son enterrement de vie de garçon en compagnie de Trivette et Gage, est perturbé par un grizzly affamé et un violent criminel qui compte empêcher les Rangers de témoigner à son procès.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Walker se marie (Partie 1)
programme.desc: Walker et Alex se marient enfin lors d'une émouvante cérémonie, mais doivent d'abord survivre à de dangereux tueurs à gages qui menacent leur mariage et leur vie.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Walker se marie (Partie 2)
programme.desc: Walker et Alex se marient enfin lors d'une émouvante cérémonie, mais doivent d'abord survivre à de dangereux tueurs à gages qui menacent leur mariage et leur vie.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La Légende du Bison Blanc
programme.desc: Une statue verse ce qui semble être de vraies larmes et Walker doit découvrir pourquoi.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E09 - Naturally Spiritual
programme.desc: In this episode we visit two different corners of our planet. Although thousands of kilometres apart, spiritually they are close relatives. First, Ethiopia in East Africa which is dissected by the Great African Rift Valley and considered by many to be the cradle of humankind. Next, a paradise on Earth: Jamaica.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: Today‘s journey in search of more miracles of nature brings us to the Masurian Lake District which is an impressive water world in north-eastern Poland. We will then trade in the cool Baltic region for tropical Caribbean. Here we will prove that it would be wrong to link the Cuban province of Guantanamo only with the famous American naval base. To wrap things up, we will return to Europe’s Mediterranean region to visit people of the Lipari Islands who continue to survive in the shade of ever-smouldering volcanoes.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive
programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E01 - The Secret Lives of Tigers
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Siberian tigers are the largest of all cats. In historic times, the tiger's range was vast, covering much of Asia. Over the last century, they've experienced an almost total population crash, and at least 97% of those tigers have gone.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E02 - The Secret Lives of Snow Leopards
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Often referred to as the gray ghost or ghost of the mountains, this animal's rarity and elusiveness was legendary. In the past, it was known as the ounce, but today we've settled on the name snow leopard.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E03 - Urban Oceans, Super Corals
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. Dive with scientists from the Earth Observatory of Singapore as they investigate the impact climate change is having on the ocean, explore engineering ideas for artificial reefs, and discover a coral species showing resilience to climate change.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E04 - Sea Level Rise and Engineering Solutions
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. South-east Asia is a unique part of the world, featuring low-lying countries, pristine islands, and vast coastal habitats. 600 million people across the region live in low elevation coastal zones, all vulnerable to sea-level rise, flooding, and extreme weather events like Tsunamis and Typhoons.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E01 - Rules of the Realm
programme.desc: Animals or groups protect their territory by using sounds like birds singing or scents like pheromones from many mammals to mark boundaries. These are just the initial warnings. If other animals ignore these signs, a conflict might happen. Animals need a secure territory to mate, raise their young, and ensure there's enough food and resources for survival. This episode looks at the strategies animals use to claim their territory.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E02 - Nature's World Wide Web
programme.desc: When animals share info to help each other decide, it's called animal communication. They use stuff like sounds, colors, body language, movements, electric signs, touches, smells, or a mix of these. Whether it's a sea anemone spreading its tentacles or a male lion considering approaching a mate, their skill in communicating can be vital for their success. This episode dives into how animals interact with one another.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: In his role as State Vet, Danny works with wealthy conservationist, Anton Ziegler, to catch a group of leopard hunters. Ziegler is also buying a tiger from Vanessa, who struggling with her finances, desperately needs the money to ensure Mara's future.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Du Plessis has started a one man campaign of vandalism against the new neighbours at Mara; Peeters and the mining company. When Peeters catches him on CCTV, Du Plessis is fined and given a restraining order to keep him away from Mara.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Du Plessis comes to meet Caroline's plane but he doesn't seem happy – he has seen that the mining company have already started building the road which threatens Leopard's Den.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: The family are making arrangements to leave Leopard's Den, all except Du Plessis who is steadfastly refusing to accept that he has lost his home. He won't use his share of the money from the sale of the land to buy somewhere else.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: The family have been squatting at Leopard's Den as they prepare to make their last stand to prevent the bulldozers from destroying their home. Du Plessis and Fatani bring elephants and a giraffe to dissuade the construction crew from moving in.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: After the devastating loss of Leopard's Den, the family are split across continents. Caroline, Liv and a heavily pregnant Alice are in the UK, while Danny and Du Plessis have remained in South Africa.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny returns to South Africa with Caroline, Liv and Charlotte. They are all excited to be back and are looking forward to seeing their new home, Clearwater Farm.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny has been preparing his pitch for an Endangered Species Project. JLW, a pharmaceutical company, are looking to fund an environmental project and the family hope that this grant money will enable them to buy Leopard's Den and Mara.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Ed release two cheetah brothers together, a symbol of their new partnership, but not all of the family are happy about this new start. Caroline is still furious at what she sees as Danny's betrayal of Du Plessis.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: The family are still estranged following Caroline's decision to move back to the decrepit Clearwater house with Du Plessis. Rosie is determined to reunite everyone, and plans a civilised dinner as a step towards reconciliation.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Danny is in prison, accused of murdering Peeters, but Du Plessis is determined to prove his friend's innocence by any means he can. Du Plessis' first attempt backfires disastrously when he harangues a police officer and ends up in a cell next to Danny.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: With Danny away, and Du Plessis undertaking an ignominious stretch of community service, Ed is left in charge of running the Endangered Species Project.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Ed are anxiously preparing for a review with JLW, the pharmaceutical company that fund their Endangered Species Project. They are desperate for it to go smoothly, and as a result are driving the rest of the family mad.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Following the loss of their funding, the family are in dire financial straits. Danny and Ed attempt to get an extension on their mortgage but are refused. Fiona spurs Ed on, telling him that the man she used to know would have a plan for survival.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Strange things are happening at Leopard's Den. The family awake to find frogs everywhere, seemingly having rained down overnight; the giraffe refuses to budge from the front gate and the cheetah is off its food.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Scabby Monkey
programme.desc: Contending with overweight cats and their over protective owners was not what Danny Trevanion had in mind when he became a vet. So when a scruffy, barely alive African monkey arrives at his practise Danny is fascinated by the challenge.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Year's Eve at Leopard's Den. Alice has returned, but the stress of combining work with caring for baby Bobby is causing tension between her and Danny. Liv is furious that Fatani hasn't told his mother about their relationship.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Paul and Perry kick off an adventurous journey down the Ivanhoe River, heading toward a lake that’s known to deliver steady walleye action. But this time, the fish had other plans. With walleye proving tough to track down, the duo turns to the river’s reliable residents—Northern Pike—to keep the rods bending and the spirits high. Surrounded by stunning scenery, flowing rapids, and beautiful waterfalls, this river run becomes more than just a fishing trip—it’s a reminder that the North’s wild beauty always makes the day worthwhile, no matter what’s biting.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri's car comes across Indravadhan's car and is just inches away from colliding before coming to halt. Indravadhan's assistants get off the car and starts scolding Gayatri. He tells that her license could get revoked. Gayatri then asks Indravadhan's assistant to hand her a pen. Gayantri writes something on a notebook and gives it to Indravadhan. Reading the note, Indravadhan too writes something on the same book and gives it to Gayatri. What did Gayathri and Indravadhan keep writing on the notebook? Keep watching to find out.Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal, but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri learns in the library that Indravadhan would be going to a village to hear people's plea. She also learns from the maid of his home that he too is going to the very same village where Indravdhan is going. Gayatri makes her mind up and plans to go along with the maid with sole purpose of catching a glimpse of Indravadhan. The next day, Gayatri's mother does not allow her to go the village but Gayatri however manages to get the permission from her mother. After reaching the village, Indravadhan hears the people's queries and assures them that he would soon find a solution for them. Later, Gayatri spots Indravadhan walking along with his guards, she runs towards him to watch him but unfortunately she slips and falls of a small cliff and then into the water.
